responsibility: This module implements GCC’s reusable text-based diagram and rich terminal rendering subsystem used for dumps and diagnostics. Its core infrastructure defines styled characters, strings, geometry, and style/theme management; builds rendered output on a 2D canvas that can emit pretty-printer text with ANSI styling, Unicode, and URL transitions; and provides abstract themes that map generic line, border, ruler, tree, CFG, and arrow cell kinds to ASCII or Unicode glyphs, including box-drawing support. On top of that foundation it supplies compositional layout and rendering primitives such as widgets, hierarchical tree widgets, labeled horizontal rulers, and span-capable tables, plus dump helpers that let GCC objects produce themed widget hierarchies for display. In short, gcc/text-art is the presentation layer for structured textual graphics in GCC, responsible for layout, styling, theming, and final emission of canvas-based diagrams rather than front-end semantics or optimization logic.
